h1: Custom Full Color Stick On Magnetic Calendars
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Stick On Magnetic Calendars | Perfect
metaDescription: Order custom full color stick on magnetic calendars for year-round brand visibility. Soft CTA included.
introHtml: Full color printing on stick on magnetic calendars gives your logo vibrant, photo-quality reproduction that stands out on filing cabinets or break room doors. Unlike single-color imprints, full color allows gradients, product images, or complex artwork to make your calendar a keepsake. Marketing directors and safety managers use these as annual giveaways that keep their company top of mind every time someone checks the date. Choose a glossy or matte finish to match your brand aesthetic.
heroAltText: Custom full color stick on magnetic calendars with vibrant logo printing on glossy finish
